idea.summary: Fear of mistakes is the real blocker: a call with another learner shows nobody is grading you, using a shared-mistake chat and the #english match instead of a tips list.

scenes.question: Practise English with...
scenes.say: Be honest. Which one sounds easier?

post.caption: You don't need perfect English to start talking. You just need someone who won't mind the mistakes. Which would you pick: a teacher or a stranger with no camera? Try a #english call at randomtalker.com (link in bio).
